title: Soundcheck comparison
description: What changed between a snapshot and the current run: compare --json, comparison.json and report --json on a comparison. Fields are only added within rhythm-soundcheck/v1.

changes.description: Most urgent first: by class, then score. Empty when nothing changed.

ignored.description: Changes that ignore rules matched, each with the rule's reason. They never pass or fail a build. Empty when none.

warnings.description: Notes on the comparison, such as settings that differ between the runs.

interrupted.description: The current run was stopped before it finished, so the result is partial. Left out when false.

id.description: The first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of check, title, source and pages: the same change has the same id in the next comparison.

check.description: The module and rule, such as health/php-error.

pages.description: Page paths; empty for a change of the whole site.

score.description: Ranks changes within a class: percent changed or slower, or the page count.

files.description: Images such as before, after and diff, relative to the comparison's folder.

reason.description: Why an ignored change was ignored: its rule's reason.

viewport.description: The viewport a visual change was seen at, such as desktop. Left out for other changes.

verdict.description: interrupted when the run was stopped, else broke when anything broke, changed when anything is new, changed or slower, clean otherwise.

failed.description: Whether the result fails at the --fail-on threshold. Left out without one.
